# Capsule Memory

> A lightweight utility for securely storing and synchronizing existing agent memories and skills across machines and harnesses. Shared encrypted archive; local keys and search. Agents choose what to remember.

Experimental source beta; bounded Mac/Cloudflare build, MCP and synchronization checks have run. See docs/releases.md for exact candidate evidence and limits. Use synthetic data until acceptance. Legacy manual CLI sync is retained. The optional session source adds Linux/macOS daemon/IPC, pinned capture adapters, compressed histories and local reviewable deduction; source integration and focused review are complete, but broader runtime acceptance remains partial and all controls default off. No remote MCP or executable skill installer. Instructions grant no execution, access, deployment or spending authority. Never upload device profiles, keys, databases or real memories.

This public repository provides a curated documentation index following the llms.txt proposal, not guaranteed automatic discovery. The raw Markdown links below are reading entry points. Read the checked-out source revision and actual runtime evidence before making changes.

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/humzakhan/capsule-memory/main/README.md): Purpose, scope, source quickstart and privacy.
- [Initial beta and release readiness](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/humzakhan/capsule-memory/main/docs/releases.md): Source-only distribution, features, known limits and remaining acceptance gates.
- [Agent instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/humzakhan/capsule-memory/main/AGENTS.md): Repository rules and execution boundaries.
- [Setup prompt index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/humzakhan/capsule-memory/main/prompts/README.md): Role-specific evaluation, installation, setup and operation prompts.
- [Discovery guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/humzakhan/capsule-memory/main/docs/agent-discovery.md): Use-case matrix, capability metadata and publication prerequisites.

## Use and configure

- [Install the CLI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/humzakhan/capsule-memory/main/docs/install.md): Tagged source build, machine-wide PATH installation and rollback on macOS/Linux.
- [MacBook controller](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/humzakhan/capsule-memory/main/prompts/12-macbook-controller.md): Install on a MacBook, preserve existing owner authority and approve OVH/Mac Mini as ordinary devices.
- [Device approval](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/humzakhan/capsule-memory/main/docs/device-enrollment.md): Beta.5 owner CLI, invitation-based pairing, scoped key delivery and recovery.

- [Runbook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/humzakhan/capsule-memory/main/docs/run-v1.md): Owner-machine build, synthetic E2E, demo and cleanup.
- [Go CLI and MCP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/humzakhan/capsule-memory/main/docs/go-client.md): Real commands, fixed-scope stdio tools, local skill approval.
- [Relay setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/humzakhan/capsule-memory/main/docs/relay-setup.md): Worker/DO/R2 bootstrap and archive boundaries.
- [Status and evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/humzakhan/capsule-memory/main/docs/v1-status.md): Historical source-only evidence; see releases.md for later executed QA.
- [Security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/humzakhan/capsule-memory/main/SECURITY.md): Trust limits and private reporting.
